familyDescription: The Meta sideboard family offers a clean-lined storage piece for dining rooms, living rooms, or hallways. Each design measures 140 × 45 × 76 cm and uses MDF with wood veneer, creating a calm, straightforward look that suits everyday storage needs. The collection is available in a natural oak finish and a brown version, allowing you to choose the tone that best fits your interior.
